items.name: build-your-own-x
items.summary: Build-Your-Own-X 是一个精心编排的教程集合，通过从零开始复现各种技术来教授编程，帮助开发者通过动手实践理解系统内部原理。其核心方法是将复杂系统分解为可学习的组件，展示基础概念如何组合成复杂工具的技术思路。你可以用它构建从数据库到游戏的各种项目，在探索常用工具底层原理的同时获得实用技能——这种“边做边学”的方式非常适合想要通过主动创造来深化编程理解的开发者，为技术成长提供了一条清晰的实践路径。
items.summary_en: Build-Your-Own-X is a curated collection of tutorials that teaches programming by recreating technologies from scratch, helping developers understand system internals through hands-on implementation. Its technical insight lies in breaking down complex systems into learnable components, demonstrating how foundational concepts combine to create sophisticated tools. You can use it to build anything from databases to games, gaining practical skills while exploring how your favorite tools work under the hood—perfect for deepening your programming knowledge through active creation.

items.name: ai-website-cloner-template
items.summary: ai-website-cloner-template 是一个开源项目，通过AI编码代理实现一键克隆任意网站。其技术核心是借助大语言模型自动逆向分析网页，生成结构清晰、可直接运行的代码。开发者只需提供目标网址，即可获得包含布局、样式和交互的完整项目副本，方便学习、定制或作为新项目起点。这一工具大幅降低了复制和改造现代网页的门槛。
items.summary_en: ai-website-cloner-template is an open-source tool that clones any website with a single command using AI coding agents. Its core innovation is leveraging large language models to automate reverse-engineering of web pages into clean, reusable code. Developers can instantly duplicate entire sites—including structure, styles, and interactivity—for learning, customization, or rapid prototyping. Simply provide a URL and let the AI handle the rest.

items.name: design.md
items.summary: DESIGN.md 是一种格式规范，让开发者用结构化文档向AI编码代理描述视觉身份。传统方式下，AI生成UI时缺乏对设计系统的统一理解，导致风格混乱。它通过一个DESIGN.md文件集中定义颜色、字体、间距等设计令牌，使所有代理共享同一套设计语言。使用方法：在项目根目录放置DESIGN.md，AI代理（如GitHub Copilot）即可自动读取并遵循规范生成界面代码。这相当于把设计系统转化为AI可读的活文档，确保多代理协作时品牌一致性。
items.summary_en: DESIGN.md is a specification that lets you describe a visual identity in a structured document for AI coding agents. Instead of relying on scattered style prompts, it gives agents a persistent, shared understanding of your design system—colors, typography, spacing, and more. By placing a DESIGN.md file in your project, you enable agents to generate UI code that consistently follows your brand guidelines. It's like a design system as code for AI collaborators.

items.name: orca
items.summary: Orca是一种智能体开发环境（ADE），专门用于并行运行多个AI编程智能体。它解决了单智能体协作效率低下的问题，核心创新在于智能体舰队式并行：每个代理独立处理不同任务，通过统一界面协调工作，大幅提升开发效率。用户可使用自有订阅运行Claude Code、Cursor Agent等代理，并支持插件扩展。适用于复杂代码审查、重构、多方案并行验证等场景，让开发者同时调用多个智能体协同作战，快速迭代代码。
items.summary_en: Orca is an Agent Development Environment (ADE) that orchestrates multiple AI coding agents in parallel, solving the bottleneck of single-agent workflows. Its core innovation is agent-fleet parallelism: each agent operates independently on different tasks, coordinated through a unified interface, dramatically boosting productivity. Users bring their own API subscriptions, run agents like Claude Code or Cursor Agent, and extend via plugins. Ideal for complex code reviews, refactoring, or cross-checking solutions across multiple agents simultaneously.

items.name: hiring-agent
items.summary: Hiring-Agent 是一个开源 AI 工具，用于自动评估和评分简历，解决招聘初期筛选效率低、主观性强的问题。它基于 Python 语言，利用大语言模型分析简历内容与职位描述的匹配度，输出客观排名。核心优势在于可定制性：用户能自定义评分权重和评估维度，并轻松集成到现有招聘流程中。典型应用场景包括海量简历初筛、减少人为偏见以及提升招聘团队效率。开发者可基于 MIT 协议自由修改和部署。
items.summary_en: Hiring-Agent is an open-source AI tool that automates resume evaluation and scoring, streamlining the initial screening process for recruiters. Built with Python and using a language model, it analyzes resumes against job descriptions to provide objective rankings. Its key strength is customization—users can adapt scoring criteria and integrate it into existing HR pipelines. Typical use cases include high-volume candidate screening, unbiased shortlisting, and reducing manual effort in hiring.

items.name: no-mistakes
items.summary: no-mistakes 是一款轻量级的 Go 语言工具，旨在确保 git push 操作无误。它通过在推送前自动执行预定义检查（如代码规范、测试等），阻止不合规代码进入远程仓库。核心设计是作为预推送钩子集成到现有工作流中，无需额外学习成本。用户可通过简单的配置文件自定义检查规则，灵活适配不同项目的质量要求。典型场景包括团队协作中自动化代码审查、减少 CI 失败、提升开发效率。对于追求代码质量的 Go 项目团队，这是一个低门槛且实用的基础设施。
items.summary_en: no-mistakes is a lightweight Go tool that ensures error-free git pushes by automatically enforcing pre-push checks. It integrates seamlessly into existing workflows, running validations like linters or tests before commits are pushed. This prevents broken code from reaching remote repositories, saving time and reducing CI failures. Developers can customize checks via a simple configuration file, making it adaptable to any project's quality standards. Ideal for teams wanting to maintain code quality without manual oversight.

items.name: headunit-revived
items.summary: headunit-revived 是一个开源项目，能将任意 Android 设备变成 Android Auto 的显示终端，无需车辆原装车载系统。它利用 Android 的投影 API 渲染 Android Auto 界面，支持自定义布局以适应不同屏幕尺寸。典型用途包括旧车改装、DIY 仪表盘，或用闲置手机作为专用导航屏。只需在兼容设备上安装，通过 USB 或无线连接即可使用。开源（AGPL-3.0）的特性使其可自由修改和扩展，尤其适合追求低成本的定制方案。
items.summary_en: headunit-revived turns any Android device into a functional head unit for Android Auto, letting you display the driving interface without a car's native system. It leverages Android's projection APIs to render the Auto UI, and being open-source, it enables customization for different screen sizes. Perfect for retrofitting older cars or building DIY dashboards—simply install on a compatible Android device and connect via USB or wireless.

items.name: bge-small-en-v1.5
items.summary: BGE-small-en-v1.5 是一个高效的英文句子嵌入模型，能够将文本转换为语义丰富的向量表示，专门解决文档相似度计算和语义搜索问题。它通过对比学习结合困难负样本挖掘，并采用知识蒸馏技术从大模型中学习，在保持轻量级的同时实现了优异的性能表现。开发者可将其用于构建智能检索系统、文档聚类分析，或作为RAG架构中的编码器，特别适合部署在计算资源有限的环境中探索语义理解应用。
items.summary_en: BGE-small-en-v1.5 is a compact English sentence embedding model that converts text into meaningful numerical representations for semantic similarity tasks. It employs contrastive learning with hard negatives and knowledge distillation from larger models, achieving strong performance despite its small size. You can use it for semantic search, clustering similar documents, or as a lightweight encoder in retrieval-augmented generation pipelines, making it ideal for resource-constrained applications.

items.summary: ms-marco-MiniLM-L6-v2是基于BERT的轻量级文本排序模型，专为语义搜索和信息检索优化。通过知识蒸馏技术压缩大型模型的语义理解能力，在保持高精度的同时显著降低计算成本。该模型可应用于智能搜索、文档检索和内容推荐系统，通过编码文本对并计算相似度实现精准语义匹配，尤其适合高效处理海量文本数据的场景。

items.name: bert-base-uncased
items.summary: BERT-base-uncased是一种双向语言理解模型，通过同时分析上下文捕捉完整语义，克服了传统单向模型的局限。其核心技术为掩码语言建模，训练时随机遮盖词汇并预测内容，从而学习深层语言规律。该模型可通过Hugging Face库加载，支持微调实现文本分类或问答功能，也可直接提取词向量用于语义相似度计算，为自然语言处理提供基础能力。

items.name: paraphrase-multilingual-MiniLM-L12-v2
items.summary: paraphrase-multilingual-MiniLM-L12-v2 是一个紧凑的多语言句子编码模型，专门解决跨语言语义理解难题，支持50多种语言的文本相似度计算。它通过知识蒸馏技术将大型多语言Transformer的能力压缩到轻量级12层架构中，同时保持跨语言语义对齐特性，让模型在不同语言间准确捕捉相同含义。开发者可直接用它构建多语言语义搜索系统、实现跨语言文档分类，或作为特征提取器用于下游NLP任务，只需输入任意支持语言的文本即可获得高质量的语义向量表示。
